definitions.explanation: The hottest part of summer, in seasonal greetings the period up to {立秋|りっしゅう} (around August 7).

examples.japanese: {暑中|しょちゅう}⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: Wishing you well in the summer heat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{暑中|しょちゅう}⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I sent a friend a summer greeting postcard.

examples.japanese: {暑中|しょちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{残暑|ざんしょ}→残暑：08559_zansho⟧⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Summer greetings are sent before the first day of autumn; after that they become late-summer greetings.

notes:
USAGE:
- Rarely used on its own today. It lives in {暑中|しょちゅう}⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧ (a summer greeting card) and the set greeting {暑中|しょちゅう}⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Summer greetings are sent from the end of the rainy season until ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧, the first day of autumn in the traditional calendar (around August 7). After that date the card becomes a ⟦{残暑|ざんしょ}→残暑：08559_zansho⟧⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧, a greeting for the lingering heat.
